title: Tip-Sea Charters at Windmill Point

services.name: Custom Charters
services.desc: Join us for a scenic afternoon eco-cruise on Carters Creek and the Rappahannock River in Virginia’s Northern Neck, where natural beauty, wildlife, and local history come together on the water. Ospreys are often seen diving for fish, bald eagles soar overhead, and dolphins may make an appearance as they move through the area. Every trip offers something unique, making it a fun and engaging experience for all ages.As we follow the shoreline, you’ll hear stories of the river’s past. Watermen, historic homes, and a way of life shaped by the tides, adding depth and meaning to the views around you. services.name: Wine Cruises
services.desc: Come enjoy some of the Northern Neck and surrounding areas finest wines while cruising the historic waterways of Virginia. Each cruise includes three bottles of local wine and a Tip-Sea Charters souvenir wine glass. Wine cruises depart from Windmill Point Marina in Whitestone VA, but local private dock pick up may be available at an additional cost. The Lil Tip-Sea, is a 1993 Parker 2520 sport cabin repowered with a Yamaha F300 outboard. Upgraded with 80 square feet of non-skid flooring and new comfortable seating. New electronics, including Lowrance chart plotter and radar, LED lighting throughout, cell phone charging stations, and Bluetooth surround sound
